clips.title: The story
paras: Rot Hide gnolls prowl the ruined fields of Garren's Haunt in northern Tirisfal. The farm once belonged to the Garren family, until the Scourge slaughtered them and left the homestead to decay.

Garren's Haunt once fed a human family under the Kingdom of Lordaeron. Before the Third War, its fields yielded bountiful harvests. When the Plague of Undeath swept across the countryside, the Scourge came to the farm and slaughtered Garren and his kin. Now gray, withered fields surround a farmhouse and barn that decay beneath Tirisfal's perpetual gloom.

Rot Hide gnolls have claimed Garren's Haunt, led by the vicious Maggot Eye. These undead-tainted scavengers defend the farm fiercely, picking clean what remains and savaging travelers or Forsaken patrols passing through northern Tirisfal.
